website.description: Find an empty plot, enter its housing lottery, collect your refund or claim your house.
website.readmeExcerpt:
Auto House Lottery

Find an empty plot, enter its housing lottery, collect your refund or claim your house. Built on Dalamud.

--- ## What it does Shows empty housing plots on a map from public listings, enters the lottery on the plot you pick or the best match on your shortlist, then checks the result and collects your refund or claims your house. Pick a plot and press **Enter**, or build a shortlist and press **Enter best match**. The plugin travels there, reads the placard, checks the plot, buyer type and deposit, and enters once per character, as the game allows. ## Features - **Find a home**: vacant plots for any world on the district map and in a list, filtered by district, ward, size, price, buyer type and lottery phase. - **Shortlist**: collect the plots you would accept, one at a time or every matching plot at once. - **Enter best match**: ranks your shortlist by open entry, fewest entries and lowest deposit, and enters the first plot that still passes the live checks. - **Run panel**: follow each step with Pause and Stop, in the window or a compact strip. - **My lottery**: your entries with deposit, lottery number and deadline, and one button each to check the result, claim the house or collect the refund. - **Several characters**: tick characters on the Characters list and press **Enter for N characters** to enter once for each, every one paying from its own gil. Characters that can claim only one plot between them are kept on the same plot, and Lifestream logs in each character in turn. - **Automatic refunds**: once results are out and you are idle, visits your entered plots and reads their results, within a travel budget and your gil reserve. With **Switch characters to collect refunds** on, it then logs in your other ticked characters that have a result waiting. - **Saved**: named searches and plot lists, with notices when a plot opens for entry, is about to close, or has results. - **Safe by design**: checks the plot at the placard and again on the confirmation, records every press before making it, and never presses twice when an outcome is unclear. - **GM alert**: ends a run when a GM is near, with optional pop-up, beeps, or custom commands. ## Multiple characters Tick characters on the Characters list in the shortlist drawer and the drawer plans exactly the ticked ones (with none ticked it plans the logged-in character as before). Each character makes at most one entry per lottery period and pays from its own gil; nothing is pooled. - **Characters list**: every character the plugin has seen logged in. Give each ticked character its own buyer type, target (the best match or one plot of the shortlist on its home world), deposit cap and reserve; anything left blank takes the filters' buyer type, the price ceiling and the shared reserve. A character that is not logged in shows the gil it had at its last login, marked as an estimate: that amount never proves or rules out that it can pay. Characters that already entered this period, or whose home world is not supported, say so. - **Ownership groups**: the game lets only one plot be claimed per Free Company for Free Company plots, and per service account and home world for private plots. Set each character's service account on the Characters list; until you do, private characters on one world count as one account, which can never produce a second win that cannot be claimed. - **Placement**: By group (the default) puts a group's characters on the same plot and spreads separate groups across the shortlist in rank order; Same plot puts every group on the top plot; Spread gives each character the next plot. A character's own target is entered exactly, with no fallback, and the rest of its group goes on that plot too, with no fallback; a member that cannot enter it, or whose own target is another plot, is left out with that reason. A character that already entered this period, or has an entry being checked, holds its group on its plot the same way, and one whose entered plot could not be read leaves the rest of its group out. When a member enters, or its own check finds it already entered, the members of its group still waiting are pinned to that plot, and any whose plan does not include it are left out, so under By group or Same plot a group never enters two plots. While a member's entry is being checked, the rest of its group waits, and the batch card says so, until a Continue reads it back from the journal; other groups go on meanwhile. Next to Placement the run preview shows the estimated chance of at least one win and, when Spread puts one group on several plots, of two or more wins, from the reported entry counts; it is hidden when any count is unknown. Spreading inside one group needs your explicit confirmation that only one of its wins can be claimed. - **Enter for N characters**: every character goes through exactly the same steps and checks as a single run, including the check for a plugin that answers dialogs on its own before each Enter Lottery, and pays its own deposit. The logged-in character goes first; right before its turn each character's gil is checked against its whole target order, and its run reads its lottery record before anything else. The batch then logs in each of the others in turn (see [Character switching](#character-switching)); when Lifestream cannot switch, they wait for their own login: log in with one of them and press **Continue** on the batch card (the chat reminds you); the card says why when Continue cannot go on. The batch card lists every character's outcome with the entries first, so characters that were left out, could not pay or have not logged in yet never hide the entries the others made. A new batch is refused while one still waits; continue it or discard it. The batch ends with the entry period. - **Several wins in one group**: My lottery asks you to choose which plot to claim (press Claim house twice on the one you want); a second claim in that group is always refused. ### Character switching The plugin switches characters itself through Lifestream's character change, for batches and, with its option on, for collecting refunds. When Lifestream does not offer it, a batch processes only the logged-in character and every other character waits for its own login, and each character's results and refunds are handled at its own login. The Plugins page (`/ahl deps`) shows whether switching is available. Before a switch, a batch saves its progress to disk, asks Lifestream to log in the next character, and does nothing for it until the game shows exactly that character (content ID and home world) and Lifestream has finished; its gil, Free Company and estates are then read again and its run reads its lottery record before anything else. No switch starts during a duty, match or world visit queue, while vnavmesh is moving you, or while AutoRetainer's multi-mode is on. The switch has a five-minute deadline; a failed login, another character chosen at the character screen, a cancel, or a plugin reload on the title screen stops the batch, and a stopped or reloaded batch continues only from your Continue. **Switch characters to collect refunds** on My lottery (off by default) lets the refund queue, once the logged-in character has nothing left to settle and you have left the game alone, log in the next character ticked on the Characters list that has a result waiting and check it there. Each character is visited once until the plugin is unloaded, never an unticked character and never one whose home world is not supported. The plugin passes only a character name and world to Lifestream and stores no account credentials. ## Install In-game: `/xlsettings` → **Experimental** → paste into **Custom Plugin Repositories**: ``` https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XeldarAlz/DalamudPlugins/main/repo.json ``` Tick **Enabled**, click **+**, then **Save and Close**. Open `/xlplugins` → **All Plugins**, search for **Auto House Lottery**, and install. The plugin needs **Lifestream** to travel to plots, and optionally **vnavmesh** to walk up to the placard. Open `/ahl deps` after install to see the list and one-click each missing one. YesAlready can stay on: the plugin pauses it while it works with the lottery dialogs and resumes it afterwards. Chinese and Korean worlds are not supported. ## Commands | Command | Action | |---|---| | `/autohouselottery` | Toggle the main window | | `/ahl` | Alias for `/autohouselottery` | | `/autohouselottery config` | Open the Settings page | | `/autohouselottery lottery` | Open the My lottery page | | `/autohouselottery saved` | Open the Saved page | | `/autohouselottery deps` | Open the Plugins page (`/autohouselottery dependencies` works too) | | `/autohouselottery log` | Open the Console page (live plugin log, copy it for bug reports) | | `/autohouselottery changelog` | Open the Changelog page | | `/autohouselottery about` | Open the About page | | `/autohouselottery stop` | Stop the run, a result visit or a batch before its next step | | `/autohouselottery pause` | Pause the run before its next step | | `/autohouselottery resume` | Resume a paused run, or continue a waiting batch | | `/autohouselottery target` | Log the targeted object's BaseId (debug helper) | Testing and maintainer commands are in [docs/testing-commands.md](docs/testing-commands.md). ## Privacy Listings come from the public housing service at `housing-api.yozoracho.dev`. The requests carry only the plugin's name and version, nothing about you or your characters, and what the plugin reads from the game stays on your machine. ## Languages The windows are available in English, Deutsch, Français, Español, Português (Brasil), Русский, Türkçe, 日本語, and 中文. The plugin picks a language from your Dalamud and game client settings on first launch; change it any time under Settings, General, Language. Game data such as world, district and zone names always follows the game client. Spotted a wrong or awkward translation? Open a [translation issue](https://github.com/XeldarAlz/FFXIV-AutoHouseLottery/issues/new?template=translation_report.yml) and tell me what it should say instead. ## Community Questions, ideas, or just want to hang out with other players? Come say hi on Discord. → [Join our Discord](https://discord.gg/hppkAvdBEE) ## More from me If you liked this plugin, take a look at my other Dalamud work. You might find something else there for you. → [XeldarAlz Dalamud Plugins](https://github.com/XeldarAlz/DalamudPlugins) ## License AGPL-3.0-or-later. See [LICENSE.md](LICENSE.md). Hunt bills, cleared for you. Built on Dalamud.

--- ## What it does Lists every daily and weekly hunt bill from A Realm Reborn through Dawntrail in one window. Tick the bills you want and press **Start**: the plugin travels to each hunt board you still need a bill from, accepts it, then teleports and flies to every mark on your bills, fights it, and moves on until each bill is done. ## Features - **Every hunt board**: Grand Company, clan and guildship bills from ARR through DT, dailies and weekly Elite Marks, with boards you haven't unlocked yet greyed out. - **Live bill progress**: reads the bills you hold and your kill counts straight from the game, so the window always matches what the game shows. - **Board pickup**: walks up to the hunt board and accepts any selected bill you aren't holding yet, and finishes an older bill before it takes the new one. - **Route planning**: groups marks by zone, so a run teleports as little as possible. - **Mark finder**: flies to each mark's known spawn points and sweeps them until it shows up, and patrols elite marks for a while before moving on. - **Hands-off combat**: fights each mark with a bundled combat preset that never pulls other mobs, and only counts a kill once the bill does. - **Recovery**: gets back up after a death and tries the mark again a few times; re-paths, jumps, or teleports out when it gets stuck. - **After-run action**: stay logged in, log out, or close the game once every bill is done. - **Auto-repair**: Dark Matter first, Grand Company mender as fallback. - **Auto-consume**: keeps food and medicine buffs up between marks, HQ first. - **Humanizer**: takes random city breaks between marks so long sessions look less mechanical. - **Pause & resume**: park a run without losing your progress, and auto-pause while you're in a duty. - **Party invites**: auto-declines incoming invites during a run after a random delay, with an optional reply message. - **GM alert**: stops the bot when a GM is near, with optional toast, beeps, or custom commands. - **History**: every run recorded with bills cleared, marks hunted, and seals or nuts earned. ## Install In-game: `/xlsettings` → **Experimental** → paste into **Custom Plugin Repositories**: ``` https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XeldarAlz/DalamudPlugins/main/repo.json ``` Tick **Enabled**, click **+**, then **Save and Close**. website.readmeExcerpt:
Auto Hunt Train

Hunt trains, ridden for you. Built on Dalamud.

--- ## What it does Hears a hunt train being called anywhere in your region, gets your character to the start aetheryte on that world, follows the conductor's flags from mark to mark, and lands a hit on every A rank before the crowd deletes it. ## Features - **Rides announced trains**: HuntAlerts detects the trains; this plugin lists them from every region under a view you pick (My data centers, My region or Everywhere), each with a countdown, a region tag when it runs outside yours, and a Ride button that takes any train in your region, on any data center, and says why it is off when it cannot. - **Train details**: click a train for its start time and countdown, start zone, aetheryte, conductor, post time and the full announcement cleaned for reading, with buttons to ride it, flag its start on the map, open the Party Finder on Hunts, point an on-screen arrow at the start, or relay a one-line summary (with ``) to any chat channel. - **Train notifications**: a chat line with a link to the train's details and an optional game sound, and, for a train you could ride on your allowed data centers, the Train page opening by itself and the taskbar flashing while the game is in the background. Switch HuntAlerts' own chat alert and banner off to avoid doubles. - **Auto-join**: off by default; switch it on per expansion to have trains joined without a click, limited to your allowed data centers, with or without data center transfers, and with the lead time a train on another data center needs before auto-join commits. A GM alert switches it off. - **Gets you there**: world change, data center travel and instance switching through Lifestream, then the plugin's own teleport and flight to the start aetheryte. - **Follows the conductor**: reads the conductor's map flags from Shout, Yell and Say, picks the nearest aetheryte or flies when the flag is close, and understands instance numbers. - **Finds the conductor**: from the announcement when it names one, from the first flag posted in the start zone, or picked by hand. - **Catches up with a train in progress**: a train more than three minutes past its start has left its start zone, so the ride estimates how far along its expansion's usual route the train has got, teleports there and listens for the next flag, moving on a zone at a time until it hears one. - **Hits, never leads**: dismounts at range, waits for the conductor's pull, lands a hit on the zone's A rank for credit, and never starts a pull or drags adds into the crowd. - **Knows when it's over**: ends the ride once every A rank of the expansion is credited, or when the conductor has gone quiet. - **Way home**: return to your home world after the train, stay for the next one, or run the after-ride action. - **Recovery**: gets back up after a death and rejoins the train; re-paths, jumps, or teleports out when it gets stuck. - **Auto-repair**: Dark Matter during a lull between flags; the Grand Company mender only before a data center transfer. - **Auto-consume**: keeps food and medicine buffs up in the lulls between flags, HQ first. - **Pause & resume**: park a ride without losing your progress, auto-pause while you're in a duty, and hold new moves while you type in chat. - **Train party**: accepts party invites during a ride so the party shares mark credit, can shout for a group at the start, and leaves the party when the ride is over. - **GM alert**: ends the ride when a GM is near, with optional toast, beeps, or custom commands. - **History**: every train recorded with world, data center, marks credited, time on the rails, and seals earned. ## Install In-game: `/xlsettings` → **Experimental** → paste into **Custom Plugin Repositories**: ``` https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XeldarAlz/DalamudPlugins/main/repo.json ``` Tick **Enabled**, click **+**, then **Save and Close**. Open `/xlplugins` → **All Plugins**, search for **Auto Hunt Train**, and install. The plugin needs a few helpers to be installed and loaded: movement, combat, travel through Lifestream, and HuntAlerts for the train announcements. Open `/aht deps` after install to see the list and one-click each missing one. Data center rides also need data center travel enabled in Lifestream's own settings. ## Commands | Command | Action | |---|---| | `/aht` | Toggle the main window | | `/hunttrain` | Alias for `/aht` | | `/aht config` | Open the Settings page | | `/aht stats` | Open the History page | | `/aht deps` | Open the Plugins page | | `/aht log` | Open the Console page | | `/aht changelog` | Open the Changelog page | | `/aht about` | Open the About page | | `/aht pause` | Pause or resume the current ride | | `/aht conductor [@World]` | Follow this player's flags; the world defaults to yours. Alone, shows the current conductor | | `/aht conductor clear` | Stop following anyone | | `/aht snooze []` | Suspend auto-join and the train notifications for the snooze length set in Settings, or for the minutes given | | `/aht snooze off` | Lift the snooze | | `/aht inject [] [i] [+] [conductor:] [body:]` | Push a made-up train announcement through the same intake as HuntAlerts, on a world in any region, so the rules, the details and the whole ride can be tried with no real train, e.g. `/aht inject Raiden DT Wachunpelo +5 conductor:Pandora Rainfall`. Everything after `body:` is the Discord post, with `\n` for a line break (debug helper) | | `/aht target` | Log targeted NPC's BaseId (debug helper) | | `/aht goto ` | Travel to a point, `/aht goto stop` cancels (debug helper) | | `/aht goto [] [i]` | Travel to a world in your region, and on it to a named aetheryte and instance, e.g. `/aht goto Zalera Wachunpelo i2` (debug helper) | | `/aht goto home` | Travel back to your home world (debug helper) | ## Languages The windows are available in English, Deutsch, Français, Español, Português (Brasil), Русский, Türkçe, 日本語, and 中文. website.readmeExcerpt:
# Aida Enna's XIV Plugin Repo

If you want to use these plugins, add `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Aida-Enna/XIVPlugins/main/repo.json` to your Dalamud repo list. 

These plugins (with the exception of Portrait Fixer which I made from scratch) were abandoned by their creators/maintainers - I've fixed them up and added new features to them. For their protection, their original author names are now omitted.

## Auto Login

Automatically logs you into a specified character when the game first opens, and optionally reconnects you to the game (and notifies you) when you get disconnected.

## Auto Pillion

When a party member gets on a mount that supports more than 1 person and is close enough, you will automatically get on.

## Macro Chain Redux

A fork of the original macro chain, this re-adds support for running a macro inside of a macro.

## Portrait Fixer

When you click "Update Gear Set", this plugin will automatically update and save your portait to match your new glam.

# Deprecated plugins

## Food Check

See who is missing food buff at countdown start and optionally post to party/echo chat with a customizable message.

This is now a main repo plugin - You will need to delete the custom repo version (using the trash can icon) and then make sure testing builds is enabled (/xlsettings -> Experimental tab -> Receive plugin testing builds), and it should show up.

website.readmeExcerpt:
Auto Seller

Your retainer listings, sold for you. Built on Dalamud.

--- ## What it does Shows your retainers' listings and everything in your bags in one list. For each row choose what happens: keep a listing the cheapest, give it your own price, or sell an item on the market board or to an NPC. Press **Sell now** or **Undercut now** and the plugin goes to a summoning bell and does it all in one trip, or switch on **Autopilot** to have it done on its own while you are idle. Nothing new is listed until you tick it, no price goes below its floor, and every sale is recorded. ## Features - **Sell page**: your listings and how they stand, everything you carry that can be sold, and one-click buttons per row: Undercut, My price, Market board or NPC. - **Autopilot**: every hour, 2 hours or 4 hours, only once you have stood still outside combat, duties and cutscenes, or after each AutoRetainer venture. - **Sell now and Undercut now**: lists and vendors only what you picked, or only checks and undercuts your listings, visiting only the retainers that need it. - **Guarded pricing**: Undercut or Match against the same quality only, bait listings ignored, floors never below vendor value, and a step limit, cooldown and price-war detection against a race to the bottom. - **Never against yourself**: your own retainers and your alts are never undercut. - **Rules**: per-item floors, ceilings, fixed prices, lot sizes, keep counts and preferred retainers, category rules with a junk rule, and Never sell for anything protected. - **Sources**: your bags and crystals, and when you opt in, a retainer's own inventory, the saddlebag and the armoury chest. - **Assist**: compares prices when you open a sell window by hand and fills the suggested price, leaving Confirm to you. - **In-game buttons**: Run all retainers on the retainer list, Reprice this retainer on a sell list, and Sell now on AutoRetainer's list. - **Undercut watch**: your listings checked against Universalis on a timer, with no game request. - **Sales**: a ledger of every sale with daily, 7-day and 30-day totals, a chart, hints on what sells fast or sits unsold, and a CSV export. - **Run controls**: Pause, Resume and Stop, auto-pause while you're in a duty, and hold new moves while you type in chat. - **Humanizer**: short random delays before moving off or teleporting. - **GM alert**: ends a run when a GM is near, with optional toast, chat line, beeps, custom commands, or closing the game. - **Runs and console**: past runs with their outcome, and every step logged on the Console page, ready to copy into a bug report. ## Install In-game: `/xlsettings` → **Experimental** → paste into **Custom Plugin Repositories**: ``` https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XeldarAlz/DalamudPlugins/main/repo.json ``` Tick **Enabled**, click **+**, then **Save and Close**. Open `/xlplugins` → **All Plugins**, search for **Auto Seller**, and install. The plugin needs **vnavmesh** to walk to a summoning bell, and uses **AutoRetainer** when it is installed to run after ventures, respect its protect list and know your alts. Open `/asell deps` after install to see the list and one-click each missing one. Runs work for the current character on its home world; for your first runs, sell one cheap item with low limits per run and watch the whole run. ## Commands | Command | Action | |---|---| | `/asell` | Toggle the main window | | `/seller` | Alias for `/asell` | | `/asell config` | Open the Settings page | | `/asell stats` | Open the Runs tab of the Sales page (`/asell history` works too) | | `/asell sales` | Open the Sales page | | `/asell deps` | Open the Plugins page (`/asell dependencies` works too) | | `/asell log` | Open the Console page | | `/asell changelog` | Open the Changelog page | | `/asell about` | Open the About page | | `/asell start` | Start a run of the current plan | | `/asell stop` | Stop the current run | | `/asell pause` | Pause or resume the current run (`/asell resume` works too) | | `/asell help` | List these commands in the chat | | `/asell target` | Log targeted NPC's BaseId (debug helper) | | `/asell look ` | Compare market prices for one item once and write them to the Console; never lists or reprices (debug helper) | | `/asell mbstatus` | Write the market checks, the search state and the age of the Universalis reference data to the Console (debug helper) | | `/asell sendpath compare\|proxy` | Choose how `/asell look` sends its searches; alone, shows which one is in use (debug helper) | | `/asell historypath window\|packet` | Choose where a retainer's sale history is read from; alone, shows which one is in use (debug helper) | ## Languages The windows are available in English, Deutsch, Français, Español, Português (Brasil), Русский, Türkçe, 日本語, and 中文. The plugin picks a language from your Dalamud and game client settings on first launch; change it any time under Settings, General, Language. Game data such as zone, item, and world names always follows the game client. Spotted a wrong or awkward translation? Open a [translation issue](https://github.com/XeldarAlz/FFXIV-AutoSeller/issues/new?template=translation_report.yml) and tell me what it should say instead. ## Community Questions, ideas, or just want to hang out with other players? website.title: FFXIV-AutoShopper
website.description: Your market board shopping list, bought for you
website.readmeExcerpt:
Auto Shopper

Your market board shopping list, bought for you. Built on Dalamud.

--- ## What it does Write down what you want from the market board, and Auto Shopper works out where to buy it. It reads Universalis prices for the worlds you allow, plans the cheapest mix of whole listings, travels there with Lifestream, walks to the market board, and buys within the caps you set, confirming every purchase before it counts. Dry run is on until you switch it off: a dry run does everything except send the purchase, so you can watch a whole run and check its numbers against the board before any gil is spent. ## Features - **Shopping lists**: search any item sold on the market board by name or id, then set its quality (Any, HQ or NQ), whether to buy a set amount or top up to what you want to own, the most it may pay per unit with the 5% market fee included, and how many extra units it may take when only bigger stacks are listed. Owned counts cover your bags, crystals, armory chest and equipped gear. Lists are kept between sessions and can be renamed, duplicated and archived. - **Imports**: paste plain text such as `3x Darksteel Ore`, a CSV, an Auto Shopper JSON export, an Artisan crafting list or a Teamcraft list. A crafting list is bought as finished items, as its direct ingredients, or expanded down to the raw materials. Nothing changes until you choose to add the rows, replace the list or start a new one. - **Crystal helper**: pick elements and kinds (shards, crystals, clusters) and they become Top up lines, so a run buys only what your crystal bag is missing. - **Exports**: lists as text, CSV or JSON, plans as a text or Markdown checklist, and run summaries as text or JSON. None of them hold character names, content ids, retainers or listing ids. - **Universalis prices**: Get prices on the Plan page reads the current listings of the list's items on the worlds you allow, chosen from a preset (current world, home data center, current data center, or whole region) and a world picker. Prices older than the age you set are flagged. - **Three plan modes**: Cheapest, Balanced (weighs the total against the stop and data center penalties you set) and Fewest stops (the fewest worlds, within a premium over the cheapest). The Plan page compares all three on the same prices and shows the route in visit order, the estimated total with the fee, your budget against the spend cap, price freshness, and every unit it could not place with the reason why. Plans buy whole listings only. - **Travel**: world changes and data center transfers through Lifestream. A transfer logs the character out and back in, and the run carries on by itself afterwards. On each world it takes the aethernet when that is shorter and walks to a market board, in your preferred city when none is in reach. - **Live listings at every stop**: the run searches each item on the board itself and plans what is left again from those listings, so a stale Universalis price never decides a purchase. - **Guarded purchases**: every purchase is checked before it is sent, written to a journal, and confirmed against the server's answer and the change in your gil and bags. See [Safety](#safety). - **Uncertain purchases**: a purchase without a clear answer stops all buying and puts a card on the Shop page with your gil and owned count before and after, so you can say whether it went through. - **Run controls**: Start, Pause, Resume and Stop on the Shop page or as commands, auto-pause while you're in a duty, hold new moves while you type in chat, and auto-resume after an unexpected error (up to 3 times in 5 minutes). - **Way home**: when a run ends on its own, back to your home world, crossing data centers when needed, then an optional after-run action (stay, return to the inn, log out, or close the game). A Stop or a fault runs neither, and logging out and closing the game are skipped after a dry run. - **Humanizer**: short random delays before the character moves off or casts a teleport. - **GM alert**: ends a run when a GM is near, with an optional toast, chat line, beeps, custom commands, or closing the game. - **History and console**: every run recorded with its outcome, list, world, data center, units, gil and time, with a summary to copy for each real run and for the last dry run. Every step is logged on the Console page, ready to copy into a bug report. ## How a run works 1. Pick a list on the Shop page and press **Start** (or type `/ashop start`). The run gets fresh prices, makes the plan, and checks that a run spend cap is set. 2. It travels to the first stop through Lifestream, changing world or data center as the plan needs. 3. It takes the aethernet if that is shorter, walks to a market board and opens it. 4. For each item on that stop it reads the live listings and plans what is left again from what the board shows. 5. Each chosen listing passes the purchase checks, is written to the journal, and is bought, one at a time. In a dry run it is logged as "would buy" instead. 6. It waits for the answer and checks your gil and bags, then moves on to the next item and the next stop. 7. When the list is covered, the cap is reached or nothing affordable is left, it travels home (when Return home is on), runs the after-run action, and records the run in History. ## Safety - **Dry run by default.** A dry run travels, searches and checks like a real run, but never sends a purchase; each one is logged as "would buy" with its price, and its journal stays in memory. The Dry run switch sits next to Start. Switching it on takes one click; switching it off asks first and says that real gil will be spent. - **Caps.** No run starts without a run spend cap. Each line can have its own most per unit (fee included) and its allowance for extra units, a run always leaves the gil you choose to keep in your purse, and Most stops limits how many worlds a plan visits. - **Every purchase is checked** before it is sent: the right character, on an allowed world it is standing on, the same item, quality and stack size as the listing chosen, a line that still needs units, the line's cap, the run's budget, the gil you keep, room in your bags or crystal pouch, unique items you already own, and no other purchase waiting for an answer. - **Refusals.** Listings from your own retainers, items on a mannequin, and set listings are never bought. - **Journal first.** The purchase is written to the purchase journal on disk before it is sent; when that write fails, nothing is sent. - **Confirmed, not assumed.** A purchase counts only when the server's answer agrees with the game's purchase events and your purse and bags changed by what they should. Anything less stops buying and asks you on the Shop page. - **One purchase at a time.** Never more than one purchase waits for an answer, and Stop waits for that answer before it ends the run. - **Interrupted runs.** A run cut short by a logout or a reload never resumes on its own: the Shop page offers to resume it with fresh prices or to discard it, and Resume is refused while dry run is on. A journal that cannot be trusted keeps buying off until you set it aside. - **What it never does**: sell or list items, touch your retainers, travel outside your home region, buy more than your list asks for beyond the extra units you allow, spend past the run spend cap or below the gil you keep, or send a purchase in a dry run. The only network traffic it makes itself is reading prices from Universalis. ## Install In-game: `/xlsettings` → **Experimental** → paste into **Custom Plugin Repositories**: ``` https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XeldarAlz/DalamudPlugins/main/repo.json ``` Tick **Enabled**, click **+**, then **Save and Close**. Open `/xlplugins` → **All Plugins**, search for **Auto Shopper**, and install. ## Requirements - **Lifestream** for world and data center travel. Runs that cross data centers also need data center travel turned on in Lifestream's own settings (`/li`). - **vnavmesh** for walking to the market board. - A **run spend cap** under Settings, Shopping. Plans work without one; runs do not start. Open `/ashop deps` after install to see both helpers and one-click each missing one. `/ashop mbstatus` says whether the market board can be read and bought on your game version; when buying is off, only dry runs start. ## Commands | Command | Action | |---|---| | `/ashop` | Toggle the main window | | `/shopper` | Alias for `/ashop` | | `/ashop config` | Open the Settings page | | `/ashop stats` | Open the History page (`/ashop history` works too) | | `/ashop deps` | Open the Plugins page (`/ashop dependencies` works too) | | `/ashop log` | Open the Console page | | `/ashop changelog` | Open the Changelog page | | `/ashop about` | Open the About page | | `/ashop add [quantity]` | Add a Buy line at Any quality to the selected list, making a list first when there is none | | `/ashop start` | Start a run of the selected list (a dry run while dry run is on) | | `/ashop stop` | Stop the run; a purchase already sent is answered first | | `/ashop pause` | Pause or resume the current run (`/ashop resume` works too) | | `/ashop look ` | Log every listing of one item at the market board in reach; it never buys (debug helper) | | `/ashop mbstatus` | Report whether the market board checks of this game version pass (debug helper) | | `/ashop board [city]` | Go to a market board and open it, in the given city (limsa, gridania, uldah, ishgard, kugane, crystarium, sharlayan, tuliyollal) or the preferred one (debug helper) | | `/ashop board stop` | Cancel the trip to a market board (debug helper) | | `/ashop target` | Log targeted NPC's BaseId (debug helper) | | `/ashop goto ` | Travel to a point (debug helper) | | `/ashop goto [] [i]` | Travel to a world in your region, and on it to a named aetheryte and instance, e.g. `/ashop goto Zalera Wachunpelo i2` (debug helper) | | `/ashop goto home` | Travel back to your home world (debug helper) | | `/ashop goto stop` | Cancel a goto (debug helper) | ## Known limits - **Universalis is an estimate.** Its prices come from player uploads and can lag behind the board, or miss a world nobody uploaded lately, and a world sends only its 100 cheapest listings. The Plan page totals are estimates for that reason, and a run re-plans from the live board at every stop. - **Retainers and saddlebags are not counted** as owned, so a Top up line can buy what a retainer already holds. - **Japanese routes are off by default.** World Visit between Japanese data centers changed on 13 October 2026, and that route is untested, so Japanese worlds outside the data center you stand on stay out of prices, plans and runs unless you allow them under Settings, Shopping. - **Start with a small list.** A purchase is confirmed only when your purse drops by the listing price plus its fee as the board shows it. Your first real purchases prove that on your client, so begin with one cheap item and a small spend cap, and keep the Console open. - **Travel stays in your home region**, and a data center transfer takes as long as Lifestream needs, logging the character out and back in. ## Languages The windows are available in English, Deutsch, Français, Español, Português (Brasil), Русский, Türkçe, 日本語, and 中文. The plugin picks a language from your Dalamud and game client settings on first launch; change it any time under Settings, General, Language. Game data such as zone, item, and world names always follows the game client. Spotted a wrong or awkward translation? Open a [translation issue](https://github.com/XeldarAlz/FFXIV-AutoShopper/issues/new?template=translation_report.yml) and tell me what it should say instead. ## Community Questions, ideas, or just want to hang out with other players? Come say hi on Discord. → [Join our Discord](https://discord.gg/hppkAvdBEE) ## More from me If you liked this plugin, take a look at my other Dalamud work. Auto Sightseeing Log

Sightseeing vistas, logged for you. Built on Dalamud.

---

## What it does Lists every Sightseeing Log vista from A Realm Reborn through Dawntrail in one window, grouped by expansion and zone. Tick the vistas you want and press **Start**: the plugin teleports and flies to each one, waits for its hour and weather when it has them, performs the emote the log asks for, and moves on until every vista you picked is in your log. ## Features - **The whole log**: all 340 vistas from A Realm Reborn through Dawntrail, grouped by zone, with the ones you haven't unlocked yet locked and what opens them one hover away. - **Live log progress**: reads which vistas you have logged straight from the game, so the window always matches your Sightseeing Log. - **Time and weather windows**: works out when each A Realm Reborn vista's Eorzean hour and weather line up, and counts down to when it opens or closes. - **Smart ordering**: visits open vistas before they close and lines up the rest for when their window opens. - **Travel**: teleports to the nearest aetheryte and flies or walks to the spot, including the vistas whose marker sits where you can't stand. - **Jump puzzles**: climbs the city jump puzzles it has a route for (Bokairo Inn and Shiokaze Hostelry in Kugane, Ruveydah Fibers Rooftop Garden in Radz-at-Han, Hunu'iliy in Tuliyollal), picks the climb back up after a missed jump, and leaves the puzzles it has no route for to you. - **The right emote**: performs /lookout, /pray, /comfort or whichever emote each vista asks for, and checks that the log recorded it. - **Hard spots**: when a vista sits on something the plugin cannot get onto by itself, it marks the spot in the world, points an arrow at it from above your character, flashes the game in your taskbar if you are in another window, and waits up to a minute for you to stand inside before carrying on. Turn it off in Settings for unattended runs. Settings also has when the box and the arrow show (always, near the spot, only when it needs you, or never) and how large the arrow is. - **Recovery**: re-paths, jumps, side-steps, or teleports out when it gets stuck on the way, and waits out a fight before it emotes. - **After the run**: stay where you are, return to the inn, log out to title, or close the game once a run finishes by itself. - **Pause & resume**: park a run without losing your progress, and auto-pause while you're in a duty. - **History**: every run recorded with the vistas logged and the zones visited. ## Install In-game: `/xlsettings` → **Experimental** → paste into **Custom Plugin Repositories**: ``` https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XeldarAlz/DalamudPlugins/main/repo.json ``` Tick **Enabled**, click **+**, then **Save and Close**. Open `/xlplugins` → **All Plugins**, search for **Auto Sightseeing Log**, and install. The plugin needs a helper for movement to be installed and loaded. Open `/asl deps` after install to see it and install it in one click. ## Commands | Command | Action | |---|---| | `/asl` | Toggle the main window | | `/sightseeing` | Alias for `/asl` | | `/asl config` | Open the Settings page | | `/asl stats` | Open the History page | | `/asl deps` | Open the Plugins page | | `/asl about` | Open the About page | | `/asl pause` | Pause or resume the current run | | `/asl goto ` | Travel to a vista without logging it (debug helper); `/asl goto stop` cancels | | `/asl logdump` | Write the Sightseeing Log state to the plugin log (debug helper) | ## Languages The windows are available in English, Deutsch, Français, Español, Português (Brasil), Русский, Türkçe, 日本語, and 中文. The plugin picks a language from your Dalamud and game client settings on first launch; change it any time under Settings, General, Language. Game data such as zone, vista, emote, and weather names always follows the game client. Spotted a wrong or awkward translation? Open a [translation issue](https://github.com/XeldarAlz/FFXIV-AutoSightseeingLog/issues/new?template=translation_report.yml) and tell me what it should say instead. ## More from me If you liked this plugin, take a look at my other Dalamud work. You might find something else there for you. → [XeldarAlz Dalamud Plugins](https://github.com/XeldarAlz/DalamudPlugins) ## License AGPL-3.0-or-later. See [LICENSE.md](LICENSE.md). website.readmeExcerpt:
Auto Treasure Maps

Treasure maps, dug up for you. Built on Dalamud.

--- ## What it does Works through the timeworn maps in your bags for you. Press **Start** and the plugin deciphers a map, travels to its dig spot, digs up the coffer, fights off the monsters that guard it, opens it, and moves on to the next map until your bags are empty. Once they are, it can gather the day's free map and buy more on the market board, if you turn those on. Portals and undersea maps are left to you. ## Features - **Decipher and dig**: reads each timeworn map you carry, works out where it points, and digs at the spot. - **Travel**: teleports to the nearest aetheryte, then flies, rides or walks to the dig spot, and lands where it can dig. - **Hands-off combat**: fights off every wave that guards a coffer with a bundled combat preset, then opens the coffer. - **Map choice**: pick which map tiers to run and whether the highest or the lowest goes first. - **Loot rolls**: answers the Need or Greed window for the coffer's items the way you choose, or leaves it to you. - **Daily map**: once a day, gathers the free timeworn map as a Miner or Botanist when the run has no map left, then switches back to your gearset (off by default). A Miner skips Gargantuaskin, whose only Miner nodes hold nothing but collectables. - **Market board**: when no map is left in your bags and no daily map can be gathered, buys the next one on the market board under a price cap you set per tier, within a gil budget per run and never below the gil you choose to keep (off by default). - **Recovery**: gets back up after a death; re-paths, jumps, or teleports out when it gets stuck. - **After-run action**: stay logged in, return to the inn, log out, or close the game once the last map is done. - **Auto-repair**: Dark Matter first, then your Grand Company mender or a repair NPC you pick. - **Auto-consume**: keeps food and medicine buffs up between maps, HQ first. - **Humanizer**: waits a random moment before each teleport, dig, coffer and fight, and takes city breaks between maps, so long sessions look less mechanical. - **Pause & resume**: park a run without losing your place, and auto-pause while you're in a duty. - **Party invites**: auto-declines incoming invites during a run after a random delay, with an optional reply message. - **GM alert**: stops the bot when a GM is near, with optional toast, beeps, or custom commands. - **Stop conditions**: a run ends when no enabled map is left, after a set number of maps or minutes, after failed maps in a row, or after a second knockout. - **History**: every run recorded with its maps, gil (less what it spent on maps), portals seen and how it ended. - **Console**: a live log of every step, with filters and a copy button for bug reports. ## Install In-game: `/xlsettings` → **Experimental** → paste into **Custom Plugin Repositories**: ``` https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XeldarAlz/DalamudPlugins/main/repo.json ``` Tick **Enabled**, click **+**, then **Save and Close**. Open `/xlplugins` → **All Plugins**, search for **Auto Treasure Maps**, and install. The plugin needs a few helpers for movement and combat to be installed and loaded. Open `/atm deps` after install to see the list and one-click each missing one. ## Commands | Command | Action | |---|---| | `/atm` | Toggle the main window | | `/treasuremaps` | Alias for `/atm` | | `/atm config` | Open the Settings page | | `/atm stats` | Open the History page | | `/atm deps` | Open the Plugins page | | `/atm log` | Open the Console page | | `/atm changelog` | Open the Changelog page | | `/atm about` | Open the About page | | `/atm start` | Start a run: decipher and run your maps until a stop condition | | `/atm stop` | Stop the current run | | `/atm pause` | Pause or resume the current run | | `/atm target` | Log targeted object's BaseId (debug helper) | | `/atm spot` | Print the deciphered map you hold and its dig spot | | `/atm flag` | Flag that dig spot on the map | | `/atm goto spot` | Travel to that dig spot and land on it | | `/atm dig` | Run the held map: travel, dig, fight the guards, loot the coffer | | `/atm decipher [map]` | Decipher the next timeworn map in your bags by the order in Settings, or the one named (a piece of its name or its item id) | | `/atm buy [map]` | Buy the next map on the market board under its price cap, or the one named (a piece of its name or its item id); market buying must be on in Settings, Maps | | `/atm gather` | Gather today's timeworn map once as a Miner or Botanist, `/atm gather stop` cancels | | `/atm tiers` | List every map tier in the Console (debug helper) | | `/atm goto ` | Travel to a point, `/atm goto stop` cancels (debug helper) | ## Languages The windows are available in English, Deutsch, Français, Español, Português (Brasil), Русский, Türkçe, 日本語, and 中文. The plugin picks a language from your Dalamud and game client settings on first launch; change it any time under Settings, General, Language. Game data such as zone and item names always follows the game client. Spotted a wrong or awkward translation? Open a [translation issue](https://github.com/XeldarAlz/FFXIV-AutoTreasureMaps/issues/new?template=translation_report.yml) and tell me what it should say instead. ## Community Questions, ideas, or just want to hang out with other players? website.readmeExcerpt:
Auto Triple Triad Grind

Every NPC card, collected for you. Built on Dalamud.

--- ## What it does Lists every Triple Triad card an NPC can give you, which ones you already own, and which NPCs drop each one. Pick single cards, whole NPCs, or every card you are missing, and press **Start**: the plugin plans a route, travels to each NPC, builds a deck for that NPC's rules, plays match after match until every card you picked from them has dropped, registers the cards, and moves on to the next NPC. ## Features - **Card collection view**: every NPC reward card from A Realm Reborn through Dawntrail, grouped by expansion, by NPC or by card, with owned cards checked off. - **Pick what you want**: click a card to pick it, click an NPC to pick everything you are missing from them, or pick every missing card at once. - **Route planning**: each card goes to the NPC that also gives the most of your other picks, and NPCs are visited zone by zone so a run teleports as little as possible. - **Deck building**: an optimized deck is built for each NPC from your own cards and that NPC's rules, including regional rules, or you can play one of your saved decks. - **Auto-play**: plays every turn with a match solver that knows all sixteen rules, then asks for a rematch until the NPC has nothing left to give. - **Card registration**: won cards are registered straight away, and the run pauses before your bags fill up. - **Farm mode**: pick one or more NPCs and play them a set number of times or until you stop. - **Skips instead of stalls**: locked NPCs, NPCs you keep losing to, and NPCs asking a higher fee than you allow are skipped and listed with the reason. - **After-run action**: stay where you are, return to the inn, log out, or close the game once the route is done. - **Pause & resume**: park a run without losing your progress, and auto-pause while you're in a duty. - **Party invites**: auto-declines incoming invites during a run after a random delay, with an optional reply message. - **GM alert**: stops the bot when a GM is near, with optional toast, beeps, or custom commands. - **History**: every run recorded with matches won, NPCs finished, and the cards you got. ## Install In-game: `/xlsettings` → **Experimental** → paste into **Custom Plugin Repositories**: ``` https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XeldarAlz/DalamudPlugins/main/repo.json ``` Tick **Enabled**, click **+**, then **Save and Close**. # BDTHPlugin

## What is it?
BDTHPlugin is a Dalamud plugin for FFXIV which gives you more control over placing housing items.

## What do I need to run it?
First, you must use the [FFXIVQuickLauncher](https://github.com/goatcorp/FFXIVQuickLauncher) to run your game. The Quick Launcher allows for custom plugins to be installed to add new functionality to the game. To install, you first need to have the Quick Launcher setup for your game, instructions can be found on the [FFXIVQuickLauncher](https://github.com/goatcorp/FFXIVQuickLauncher) page.

## How do I install it?
### **[Please visit this page on how to install my plugin via third party repository support.](https://github.com/LeonBlade/DalamudPlugins)**

### **ONLY ASK FOR HELP FOR THIS PLUGIN FROM ME OR ON MY DISCORD SERVER**

## How do I use it?
`/bdth` brings up the window to move items around. You **MUST** be in rotate mode for it to work.

Enabling the "Place Anywhere" checkbox will remove restrictions on placing items down for most cases.

Enabling the "Gizmo" checkbox will give you access to a movement tool in game to manipulate the selected object on all three axis.

Enabling the "Snap" checkbox will lock your gizmo movements to the interval defined in the "drag" box at the bottom.

Clicking on the image button will change the movement mode to world and local movement.

Click and drag on the boxes to change their values based on the drag input, alternatively, use the + and - buttons on the other inputs to adjust by the drag value as well. You can also enter numbers in here if you like by typing them.

`/bdth list` opens a furnishing list used for indoors. Allows you to sort objects by distance to refine the list of items in item dense house.

## FAQ
Please check out the [FAQ](https://github.com/LeonBlade/BDTHPlugin/wiki/FAQ) page to see if your issue might be listed here.

## Final message
Thank you for using my tool, I'm very grateful to everyone who uses my tools and I enjoy seeing what people do with them. If you wish to support me, you can do so at any of the links below. You can also join at the Discord to ask questions or share your creations.

# Boss Mod Boss Mod (vbm) is a Dalamud plugin for FFXIV that provides boss fight radar, auto-rotation, cooldown planning, and AI. All of the its modules can be toggled individually. Support for it can be found in the [Puni.sh Discord server](https://discord.gg/Zzrcc8kmvy). _Licensed under the terms of the ![BSD 3-Clause License](/LICENSE)_ # Radar The radar is the main part of the plugin and the primary reason for its existence. It provides an on-screen window that contains area mini-map that shows player positions, boss position(s), various imminent AoEs, and other mechanics. This is useful because you don't have to remember what ability names mean and you can see exactly whether you're getting clipped by incoming AoE or not. The radar module also provides the next mechanic(s) in text form, as well as hints for how to resolve the current mechanic from the perspective of the group and the player. # Autorotation For supported classes, the Autorotation module will execute a fully optimal rotation to the best of its ability. Individual job support is listed in the plugin. A small guide on using this can be found [here](https://github.com/awgil/ffxiv_bossmod/wiki/Using-Presets). The features include: - Movement skills are not executed during parts of fight that require precise positioning - oGCDs are queued to next free oGCD slot so GCDs are not delayed - Preventing movement while casting that allows perfect slidecasting - Ground-targeted abilities, are cast immediately and are queued properly - Abilities select the "best" target automatically # Cooldown Planner The CD Planner allows you to turn your autorotation configuration into a plan for a specific boss fight. For instance, during a boss fight, you can automatically cast a raid-wide mitigation ability right before the boss casts an AoE. All of the options from autorotations are supported in a CD planner, which include "tracks" for using role-based abilities, limit break, cooldowns, and more. These are all configured on a per-boss basis. A small guide on using this can be found [here](https://github.com/awgil/ffxiv_bossmod/wiki/Using-the-CD-Planner:-Basic-Tutorial). For an advanced version of the CD Planner with extended functionality and enhanced capabilities, please refer to the comprehensive guide available [here](https://github.com/awgil/ffxiv_bossmod/wiki/Using-the-CD-Planner:-Advanced-Plan-Making-using-Replays). # AI VBM's AI module was created to automate movement during boss fights. With the help of other plugins, entine dungeons can be completely automated, provided a module exist for each boss. The AI will move your character based on safe zones determined by a boss's module, which are also displayed on the radar. It also tries to keep you within range of the enemies you are attacking while you're in combat with them. An example of a plugin that utilizies VBM's AI module is [AutoDuty](https://github.com/ffxivcode/AutoDuty), which is supported in the same [Discord server](https://discord.gg/Zzrcc8kmvy) that VBM is supported in.
# Installation Add `https://puni.sh/api/repository/veyn` to your plugin repositories and then search for `Boss Mod` in the Plugin Installer to install Boss Mod. Settings can be accessed via the Plugin Installer or using the chat command `/vbm`. # Getting help When you've found a bug or think you have some issue with the plugin, please do the following: 1. Ask in [Discord](https://discord.gg/Zzrcc8kmvy): it might be a known issue or people might be able to help you quickly 2. Gather extra information to aid in investigating the issue: 1. Set log level to "Debug" (type `/xldev`, select "Dalamud" -> "Set log level" -> "Debug") 2. Start replay recording (type `/vbm r` and hit "Start Recording") 3. Reproduce the issue 4. Stop replay recording (hit "Stop Recording") 5. Find the logs (typically at `C:\Users\username\AppData\Roaming\XIVLauncher\dalamud.log`) 6. Find the replay (typically at `C:\Users\username\AppData\Roaming\XIVLauncher\pluginConfigs\BossMod\replays`) 3. Create a [new issue](https://github.com/awgil/ffxiv_bossmod/issues/new/choose) on GitHub, provide a detailed description of the problem (including steps to reproduce the issue), and attach the logs and replay **Do NOT** create GitHub issues to request new modules, ask questions, etc.
Our channel (`ffxiv-bossmod`) on the [Puni.sh Discord server](https://discord.gg/Zzrcc8kmvy) is much more convenient for these kinds of things. **Do** create GitHub issues for very concrete bugs (if you have replays, logs, or an easy way to reproduce what is obviously a problem) or very specific feature requests (please discuss in Discord first to understand whether there's any interest in it). # Contributing One of the best ways to contribute to Boss Mod is by making modules for boss fights. If you are looking for which bosses don't have modules, you can look in the `/BossMod/Modules` folder of the repository. To make modules, it's suggested to follow the [Making a Module](https://github.com/awgil/ffxiv_bossmod/wiki/Making-a-Module) guide on the repo's wiki, as well as the [Making a Module: What kind of attacks exist?](https://github.com/awgil/ffxiv_bossmod/wiki/Making-a-Module:-What-kind-of-attacks-exist%3F) wiki entry. There are quite a few people in the Discord server who know how to make modules, so feel free to ask for help there.

# [![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/FFXIV-CombatReborn/RebornAssets/main/IconAssets/BMR_Icon.png)](https://github.com/FFXIV-CombatReborn/BossmodReborn)

**BossmodReborn**

![Github Latest Releases](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/FFXIV-CombatReborn/BossmodReborn/latest/total.svg?style=for-the-badge)
![Github License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/FFXIV-CombatReborn/BossmodReborn.svg?label=License&style=for-the-badge)
[![](https://dcbadge.limes.pink/api/server/p54TZMPnC9)](https://discord.gg/p54TZMPnC9)

BossmodReborn is a community-driven fork of the original Bossmod plugin for Final Fantasy XIV. It aims to enhance your gameplay by providing real-time tactical guidance and tools that simplify complex raid mechanics. This tool is invaluable for optimizing in-game strategies, ensuring precise positioning, and enhancing overall raid performance.

## Features

- **Advanced Radar System**: A sophisticated on-screen map displaying player and boss positions, imminent AOEs, and other crucial mechanics. This system helps players visualize the battlefield, simplifying decision-making processes.
- **Mechanic Descriptors**: Near the radar, you’ll find clear, concise descriptions of upcoming mechanics, global hints for resolving current challenges, and personalized player advice to optimize your response to each situation.
- **Cooldown Planner**: A tool for meticulous planning of ability usage, ensuring optimal timing for cooldowns and abilities in coordination with raid strategies.
- **User-Friendly Interface**: Designed with accessibility in mind with a wonderful module viewer by Croizat, the interface is intuitive, allowing players of all skill levels to benefit from the plugin.
- **Regular Updates**: Committed to staying current with the latest game patches, class updates, and community feedback. PRs will be reviewed, tested, and approved.

## Want to contribute?

- Create a fork
- Make your changes
- Test the changes
- Create a PR and point it to main

## Fork for CN client
- A fork for players on the CN client can be found on https://github.com/44451516-ff14/BossmodRebornCN.
- It is not directly supported by the Combat Reborn Team, so any bugs exclusive to that fork need to be fixed by the fork maintainer.
- Bugs that likely affect both BossmodReborn and the CN fork can still be reported to the Combat Reborn Team.

website.description: A FFXIV Dalamud plugin for improving the GPose experience in FFXIV.
website.readmeExcerpt:
# BRIO - A FFXIV plugin to enhance the GPosing experience. 
[![Build status](https://github.com/Etheirys/Brio/actions/workflows/build.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Etheirys/Brio/actions/workflows/build.yml) ![GitHub Downloads (all assets, all releases)](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/Etheirys/Brio/total?style=flat) [![Latest Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/Etheirys/Brio)](https://github.com/Etheirys/Brio/releases/latest) ![GitHub License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/Etheirys/Brio?style=flat) ![Bluesky followers](https://img.shields.io/bluesky/followers/minmoose.bsky.social?style=flat&label=bluesky%20followers) ![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/1198316676865867776?label=discord) 

> Brio is currently in BETA, as such, there may be bugs. If you find any, please report them!

## Features
* Full Actor Posing
  * While animating
  * Adjust actor positions without them resetting
  * Overlay and graphical posing modes
  * Inverse Kinematics (IK) posing
  * Full-pose Mirroring/Fliping
  * Import and export poses to a `.pose`
* Actor Management - Creation and Deletion of up to 239 GPose Actors
  * Add/Remove/Blend any animation on a GPose actor (and adjust their speed!)
  * Spawn and attach Companions to actors (minions, mounts, and ornaments)
  * Edit Actor Appearances
  * Swap gear, weapons, and dyes
  * Change the Penumbra collection, Glamourer design & C+ Profile, applied to GPose actors
  * Full character customization (race, tribe, gender, and appearance sliders)
  * Advanced appearance and model shader/color options
  * Add/Remove Status Effects on GPose actors
* Vivacity - Brio's full Keyframe timeline, animate anything! Actors, world objects, cameras, and lights!
  * Keyframe positions, rotations, bones and even full poses, the camera, lights even the colors of them!
  * Play XAT's .xcp camera files
  * Has Bezier interpolation or step interpolation keyframes
* World Object spawning! From weapons, to furniture, or that rock over there. If you can see it, you can spawn it!
  * Spawn props, housing furniture, background world objects, and VFX
  * Browse it all in a searchable, categorized Object Catalog
* Creation of fully customizable lights!
* Create virtual cameras and move them freely beyond GPose's normal limits
  * Includes Free Cameras!
* Creation & Loading of MCDFs that can be loaded onto GPose actors
* Save/Load the entire GPose scenes (actors, world objects, lights, cameras, and environment)
* Browse your character and pose collection with a searchable, tag-based Library!
* Overlay reference images while posing
* Control Time/Weather in both the Overworld and GPose
* Change the active festivals, apply up to 8 at once! (ie, Moonfire Faire for fireworks)

## Installation
### You can install Brio in one of two ways, 

#### 📦 With the [Sea of Stars](https://github.com/Ottermandias/SeaOfStars) **(Recommended)** Custom Dalamud Repository.
  - Type `/xlsettings` in the chat window, then go to the **Experimental** tab.
  - Under the **Custom Plugin Repositories** section, add the following Dalamud repo:
  ```
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Ottermandias/SeaOfStars/main/repo.json
  ```
  - Click on the + button & ensure the ***Enabled*** box is checked on the repo.
  - ***Click on the save button in the bottom right***
  - Now open the **Dalamud Plugin Installer** by opening FFXIV's System Menu then pressing ***Dalamud Plugins***
  - In the Search box type `Brio`, find & click on ***Brio*** and then click `Install` after Dalamud has finished installing **Brio**, make sure the *Brio* plugin is Enabled in the Plugin Installer.
  - You now have **Brio** Installed, ***Brio will now open when you are in G-Pose***, you can also type `/brio` in chat to open the Brio Window.

#### 🏗️ With the [World Of Etheirys ](https://github.com/Etheirys/WorldOfEtheirys) Custom Dalamud Repository.
                      
  - Type `/xlsettings` in the chat window, then go to the **Experimental** tab.
  - Under the **Custom Plugin Repositories** section, add the following Dalamud repo:
  ```
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Etheirys/WorldOfEtheirys/main/repo.json
  ```
  - Click on the + button & ensure the ***Enabled*** box is checked on the repo.
  - ***Click on the save button in the bottom right***
  - Now open the **Dalamud Plugin Installer** by opening FFXIV's System Menu then pressing ***Dalamud Plugins***
  - In the Search box type `Brio`, find & click on ***Brio*** and then click `Install` after Dalamud has finished installing **Brio**, make sure the *Brio* plugin is Enabled in the Plugin Installer.
  - You now have **Brio** Installed, ***Brio will now open when you are in G-Pose***, you can also type `/brio` in chat to open the Brio Window.

## Support
Brio is still early in development so issues are to be expected.

If you encounter an issue, please either, visit us on the BRIO discord [World of Etheirys Discord](https://discord.gg/GCb4srgEaH ), [Aetherworks Discord](https://discord.gg/KvGJCCnG8t) or open an [issue](https://github.com/Etheirys/Brio/issues)!

## Authors 
**[Minmoose](https://github.com/Minmoose) - Maintainer & Developer.**

**[Asgard](https://github.com/AsgardXIV) - Original Maintainer & Developer.**

**Thank You, to all of our [Contributors](https://github.com/Etheirys/Brio/graphs/contributors)!**

## Acknowledgements
Brio wouldn't be possible without the tireless work of many devs across many projects.

A special thanks goes to:

Find out more [here](https://github.com/Etheirys/Brio/blob/main/Acknowledgements.md).

website.description: Browse FFXIV's wardrobe like a boutique.
website.readmeExcerpt:
# The Crystarium Boutique

**Browse FFXIV's wardrobe like a boutique.**

Current release: **v0.1.5**

The Crystarium Boutique (TCB) was created because building a glamour should feel like browsing a wardrobe—not searching item-name databases, juggling external sites, and repeatedly opening separate preview windows.

> **See something interesting → click it → see it on your character.**

Browse equipment visually, experiment with pieces and dyes, save ideas, organize discoveries, and learn where supported items come from without leaving the Boutique.

**Quick links:** [Features](#features) · [Installation](#installation) · [Discord Community & Video Guide](#video-guides--discord-community) · [Support](#support) · [License](#license-and-credits)

> ### Want to see TCB in action?
>
> Join the [TCB Discord community](https://discord.gg/qfcKTPr3gX) and visit its **Guide** section for video demonstrations and screenshots of the features explained below.

## Features

### Visual Boutique

Browse FFXIV equipment as an icon-first wardrobe instead of an item-name list. Choose an equipment slot, move freely through visual pages, and discover pieces you may not have known existed. Newer equipment appears first, filters narrow the catalog, and unusable equipment is visually distinguished where supported.

TCB deliberately keeps meaningful visual variants separate, including where applicable:

- Baked color and material differences
- Different dye-slot support
- Relic stages
- Glowing and standard replicas
- Matte replicas
- Other versions with meaningfully different appearances

Items sharing a model remain separate obtainable items. TCB does not collapse them merely because they look alike.

### Real-time preview

Left Click an item to preview it immediately on your character. Rapidly swap pieces, mix different sets, and keep the active Boutique appearance while experimenting—without repeatedly using FFXIV's separate preview windows.

For Head items:

- **Left Click** applies the headpiece with its optional visor piece hidden.
- **Ctrl + Left Click** applies its full or alternate visor appearance when supported.
- Headgear without a supported visual difference remains safe and simply looks the same.

### Revert to Last Item

The bottom-right Revert control restores the immediately previous Boutique selection for that equipment slot. It is available in both Boutique and Favorites, and both views share the same previous-item history. A normal successful Revert changes only that selection rather than resetting the full character.

### Crystal Wardrobe and real-time dyes

Crystal Wardrobe is TCB's working canvas. It shows the active previewed equipment and both supported dye channels, lets you remove individual pieces where supported, and can automatically synchronize after FFXIV applies a genuine gearset change.

- **Dye Slot 1** and **Dye Slot 2** open the Dye Studio for immediate dye preview.
- Compatible replacement equipment retains relevant active dyes.
- Individual dye channels can be removed independently.
- **Clear All Dye Slots** removes active dyes while keeping the current equipment intact.
- **Reset Character** returns the Wardrobe and character to the current game state.
- Vertical and Horizontal layouts are available, and the Wardrobe window adapts its dimensions when orientation changes.

Right Click an equipped Wardrobe card removes that piece from the current Boutique appearance where supported. Right Click in the main Boutique remains Favorites management.

**Clear All Dye Slots affects only active dyes in the current Boutique session.** It does not edit dyes stored in saved Designs. Loading a saved Design can intentionally restore that Design's saved dyes.

### Search and filters

Combine filters to focus the visual catalog:

- Equipment Slot
- Expansion
- Role, including Limited Role where applicable
- Dye Slots
- Required Character Level
- Item Name / Search

The **Level** control is manual numeric entry and uses the item's required/equip character level—not Item Level. Entering `60`, for example, shows equipment requiring levels 1–60.

The Designs control is also available directly from the Boutique so saved appearances can be used while browsing.

### Favorites and custom lists

Right Click a Boutique item to save it as a Favorite. All Favorites provides one combined collection, while custom named lists can organize pieces by job, character, theme, or glamour concept. The same item may belong to multiple lists.

Favorites support search, equipment-type filtering, direct preview, newest-first ordering, and Revert to Last Item. From a named list, an item can be removed from only that list without losing its other memberships, or removed from Favorites completely.

The upper-right Favorite emblem identifies saved items throughout normal Boutique browsing. An optional configurable Favorite frame is available and defaults to off.

Favorites can be as simple as:

> “I don't know what I'm doing with this yet, but I definitely want to remember it.”

Or as intentional as:

> “I have a concept—let's make a list of things that might work.”

### Designs

A Design stores equipment, dyes, weapon pieces, a custom name, and optional notes. Save completed glamours or unfinished ideas, then manage them from the Designs tab.

Available operations include:

- Preview/load and inspect equipment and dyes
- Rename
- Duplicate
- Overwrite/update
- Delete
- Review acquisition information
- Generate a movable item-reference/checklist window

If a Design contains equipment that cannot validly apply to the current job, TCB retains valid active equipment for that slot instead of presenting incompatible gear as successfully active.

**Export Design** creates a portable TCB Design string. **Import Design** saves another player's compatible TCB Design string for later loading.

TCB can also import supported public Eorzea Collection glamour URLs. The imported appearance can be previewed, changed, dyed, and saved as a normal TCB Design. See [Design Import](docs/DESIGN-IMPORT.md) for supported formats and limitations.

### Item information and where to get it

Hover an item to see its identity, level, dye support, and locally indexed acquisition details. Where sufficiently reliable data exists, TCB can describe:

- **Vendors:** vendor name, location, currency, and exchange cost
- **Crafting:** crafting job, recipe requirements, and required materials
- **Quests and achievements:** quest sources/rewards and achievement rewards
- **Other sources:** Market Board, Mog Station/FFXIV Online Store, Treasure Hunt, and other obtainable-from information
- **Duties:** Dungeons, Trials, Raids, Savage content where represented, Alliance Raids, duty names, duty drops, boss chests, duty chests/coffers, and raid series/tier information
- **Shared appearances:** other separately obtainable items using the same appearance/model family

Exact bosses are named only when reliable item-to-source evidence establishes that relationship. Missing acquisition information does **not** mean an item is invalid, unobtainable, or unavailable; it means TCB does not currently have sufficiently reliable information for that source.

Core catalog and packaged acquisition lookup are local and offline during normal browsing. See [Data Sources](docs/DATA-SOURCES.md) for provenance and limitations.

### Known-owned item indicators

When TCB can positively confirm that the current character owns an exact item, its card displays a green checkmark in the upper-left. Supported sources are:

- Inventory
- Equipped gear
- Armoury Chest
- Armoire
- Glamour Dresser

A green check means TCB knows that exact item is owned. No check means TCB does not currently have confirmed ownership information—it does not prove the item is unowned.

Ownership is exact-item only. A visually identical shared-model, replica, relic-related, or alternate-color item does not receive a check unless **that exact item** is known owned. The Favorite emblem remains in the upper-right, so Favorite and ownership status can appear together.

To track Glamour Dresser ownership, open the Glamour Dresser at least once on **each character**. After a complete successful dresser load, TCB stores a per-character snapshot. Its checks survive zoning, plugin reload, and game restart; opening the dresser again refreshes the saved snapshot.

TCB does not currently claim ownership from Saddlebags or Retainers.

### Themes and customization

TCB includes three themes:

1. **The Crystarium Boutique** — stained-glass presentation with decorative metal and gold framing.
2. **Simple Crystarium Boutique** — Crystarium-inspired colors and typography with a cleaner, restrained background.
3. **Simple** — the compact neutral Dalamud-style presentation.

Fresh configurations default to **The Crystarium Boutique**. Existing users retain their saved theme choice when updating.

Appearance settings include font and button colors, background transparency, Favorite highlighting, interface scaling, layouts, tooltip presentation, and other theme-specific options.

## Video Guides & Discord Community

This README explains the complete player-facing feature set, but many features are easier to understand by watching them.

Join the [TCB Discord community](https://discord.gg/qfcKTPr3gX) and visit the **Guide** section for screenshots and videos demonstrating:

- Visual Boutique browsing and real-time preview
- Visor controls and Revert to Last Item
- Crystal Wardrobe and Dye Studio
- Search, filters, Favorites, and Favorite lists
- Designs, Design dropdown usage, import, and sharing
- Acquisition tooltips and shared appearances
- Themes and customization
- Known-Owned indicators and Glamour Dresser tracking

The Discord also provides announcements, update information, installation help, feature explanations, bug reports, feedback, feature requests, glamour discussion, Design sharing, community glamour showcases, and general TCB discussion.

**Permanent invite:** https://discord.gg/qfcKTPr3gX

## Installation

Add the public TCB repository to Dalamud's **Experimental / Custom Plugin Repositories**:

```text
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Aesthria/The-Crystarium-Boutique/main/repo.json
```

1. Open Dalamud Settings and add the URL under Experimental/Custom Plugin Repositories.
2. Save and refresh the repository list.
3. Open `/xlplugins`.
4. Search for **The Crystarium Boutique** and install it.
5. Future releases will appear through Dalamud's normal plugin-update flow.

See [Installation](docs/INSTALLATION.md) for expanded setup and update guidance.

## Requirements

- Windows
- FINAL FANTASY XIV through XIVLauncher with a current Dalamud installation
- Glamourer installed separately for appearance preview and restoration
- Penumbra installed separately only if its optional emergency redraw fallback is desired

Without Glamourer, TCB remains usable in browse-only mode. Penumbra is an optional emergency redraw fallback if Glamourer unloads during an active preview. Neither dependency nor either API assembly is bundled with TCB.

## Commands

- `/boutique`
- `/tcb`
- `/cb`

All three commands toggle the same Boutique experience.

## Privacy and local-first behavior

TCB uses local game data for its equipment catalog and packaged local data for acquisition lookup. Favorites, Favorite lists, settings, Designs, and per-character Glamour Dresser ownership snapshots are stored locally.

Normal browsing does not contact a live price or acquisition service. The explicit Eorzea Collection URL import is the exception: TCB accesses the requested external resource only after the player submits a supported public URL.

## Support

Start with [Troubleshooting](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md), then consult [Support](SUPPORT.md) for reporting guidance. Security-sensitive concerns belong under the [Security Policy](SECURITY.md).

For feature demonstrations, installation discussion, feedback, Design sharing, and community help, join the [TCB Discord](https://discord.gg/qfcKTPr3gX).

## Dependencies and data sources

TCB is built with the Dalamud plugin SDK and uses Lumina-backed game data exposed by Dalamud. It interoperates with independently installed Glamourer and Penumbra through narrow Dalamud IPC contracts.

TCB does not bundle `Glamourer.Api.dll`, `Glamourer.dll`, `Penumbra.Api.dll`, `Penumbra.dll`, or `Luna.dll`.

The acquisition supplement is packaged for offline use from pinned, reviewed sources and validated stable IDs. See [Dependencies](DEPENDENCIES.md), [Data Sources](docs/DATA-SOURCES.md), and [Third-Party Notices](THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md).

## Building from source

The validated build targets .NET 10, Windows x64, and Dalamud API 15. Install the SDK selected by `global.json` and provide a compatible Dalamud development environment.

```powershell
dotnet restore CrystariumBoutique.sln --locked-mode
.\scripts\Build.ps1 -Configuration Release -SkipStage
```

Maintainer packaging and release procedures are documented in [Release Infrastructure](docs/RELEASE.md).
